extracted.intended_audience: PubMed users (researchers, clinicians, librarians) seeking to determine whether journals are peer-reviewed
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for PubMed users on whether journals indexed in PubMed are peer-reviewed and where to find lists or indicators of peer review, including alternative bibliographic resources and how to verify a journal's policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: No NLM list or PubMed filter for peer-reviewed journals
rubrics_metrics.description: NLM has no list of peer-reviewed or refereed journals. You cannot limit a PubMed® search to peer-reviewed or refereed journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PubMed does not provide a built-in way to restrict results to 'peer-reviewed' titles; users should not expect to be able to filter PubMed by peer-review status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Most PubMed-indexed journals are peer-reviewed but criteria vary
rubrics_metrics.description: Most journals indexed for PubMed are peer-reviewed or refereed, but peer review criteria and reviewer or referee qualifications vary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume uniform peer-review standards across titles; the presence of peer review and the rigor of the process differ by journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify peer-review by checking editorial information or contacting the publisher
rubrics_metrics.description: Check a journal's editorial information or ask the publisher about policy for specific journal titles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For a given journal, consult its editorial/publishing policies (usually on the journal website) or contact the publisher directly to confirm whether and how peer review is conducted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use CINAHL's 'Peer Reviewed' subset as an identifier
rubrics_metrics.description: Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature (CINAHL) database, published by EBSCO, has a Peer Reviewed subset.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CINAHL can be used (where available) to limit searches to peer-reviewed journals; access is typically provided through libraries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference: Medical and Health Care Books and Serials in Print marks refereed titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Medical and Health Care Books and Serials in Print, edited by Bowker staff and published by Grey House Publishing; the Serials volume has a symbol in front of refereed journal titles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This print/resource reference identifies refereed journals with a symbol; availability may depend on library holdings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Ulrichsweb to check whether a journal is refereed
rubrics_metrics.description: Ulrichsweb: a Global Serials Directory published by ProQuest LLC, provides information on each journal record if it is a refereed journal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ulrichsweb records indicate whether a journal is refereed; access typically requires a subscription through an institution or library.
